title: Fee tier boundary is wrong
prompt: Customers report that sending exactly QAR 500.00 to India is charged the fee of the next tier up. Find the cause in the fee code and fix it. Change as little as you can and do not edit the tests.

title: Why the express fee can pass the cap
prompt: Read src/remit/fees.py and explain in three sentences how the express surcharge relates to the fee cap, and what that means for the largest transfers. Write your answer to ANSWER.md in the repository root. Do not change any other file.

title: Quote as JSON
prompt: Add a --json flag to `python -m remit quote`. With it, print exactly one JSON object and nothing else, with the keys send_amount, fee, total, rate, receive_amount and delivery_method. Amounts and the rate are strings that keep their decimals, for example "fee": "12.00". Without the flag the output must not change. Add a test.

title: Tests that notice the express rule changing
prompt: The express surcharge is added after the fee cap in src/remit/fees.py, so a large express transfer pays more than the cap. Write tests in tests/test_fees_express_cap.py that pin this down: they must pass on today's code and fail if the cap covered the surcharge too. Do not change any source file.
